soundness_flags.label: def:diagnostics / prop:diagnostic-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The held-out residual and gain diagnostic is not mathematically defined from declared objects: no estimated active-only fold optimizer or explicit held-out residual formula exists, although consistency of both is claimed.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define fold-specific active-only optimizers, estimated enriched residuals, centering, and their held-out variance products explicitly; then state the diagnostic consistency target using those objects.

Add a source-anchored comparison theorem that maps the published finite prescribed-basis construction to the proposed growing full-arm sieve and isolates the primitive condition that makes the latter a strict extension.
Place direct page/section anchors for the global-efficiency-open statement and the finite-basis theorem in each flagship statement’s gap field, not only in the literature map.

recommended_next_step: Revise the diagnostic definitions and consistency claim, then continue to Stage 0 with the field-tier global-attainment kernel.
